input: Build a LAMMPS data file in the class II PCFF-INTERFACE force field (INTERFACE FF 1.5) for a PCE with 6 butenyl-ether side chains of 4 ethylene-oxide units (OH-terminated) and 12 acrylic acid units of which half are deprotonated (the rest stay COOH), random sequence, sodium counter-ions.
note: COOH typing in class II is a trap (o_2/ho2, not oh/ho)
